originality.rationale: For every n>=k>=4 this classifies the complete S_n x C_2 rational homology character of the ordinary clique-prism k-cut complex. The 2023 theorem covers homotopy type and ranks but not the symmetry representation; the two closest public derived representation results are restricted to cut size three with both rook factors at least three or to total cut size two. The dual-complex argument yields an irreducible hook and an independent layer-parity effect, not supplied by those antecedents. Search limits are explicit.
residual_risks: Semantic searches and indexed records cannot eliminate unindexed or differently phrased equivalent equivariant classifications.
The accessible follow-up-paper abstract cannot alone establish its full text does not contain a related higher-cut prism statement; this was not treated as a decisive negative inspection.
The general application of equivariant Alexander duality is standard, but the module computation and parameter restriction are independently proved here; a hidden prior computation remains possible.

value.rationale: A natural infinite two-parameter topological family with known sphere counts gains its complete single-irreducible hook symmetry module and a parity-dependent global layer character, all traces and invariant-class obstruction. This is not recoverable from dimension/homotopy type alone; it addresses an explicit equivariant gap in the original study without arbitrary parameter tuning.
